description:
[Reports] Save a new custom report from a definition (schema jobmojito.report/v1). It is created as Only me: tell the user they can share it from the returned admin_url. Check the definition with preview_report first.

Stores a new custom report. It is created as "Only me" (private to you); share it from the JobMojito admin. Returns its id, version and the admin link to open it. Check the definition with preview_report first.

conversation_id.description: Pass the exact conversation_id from the server's previous response, unchanged. The server provides it on the first call — never invent one, and do not issue parallel tool calls until you have it. Keep passing the same conversation_id for the rest of the conversation, including after later user messages or on a different task; do not reset it when the user starts a new request.

definition.description: A custom report: report-wide filters and up to 12 blocks. Read report-catalog first for the dataset, field and measure ids.

compare.description: kpi / funnel only: also return the same numbers for the period before.

dataset.description: Dataset id from report-catalog. Not used by a text block.

grain.description: For a date field: day (default), week, month, quarter or year.

items.description: A dimension field id, or {"field", "grain"} for a date.

limit.description: Rows for a table / bar / line. Default 100 (line 500).

measures.description: 1 to 6 measure ids of the dataset.

field.description: A dimension or measure the block selects.

text.description: Text block only: the note (plain text, line breaks kept).

type.description: kpi: one total per measure (no dimensions; add compare previous_period for a change). funnel: 2+ measures as steps (no dimensions). table: 0-2 dimensions. bar: 1-2 dimensions. stacked_bar: exactly 2 dimensions. line: first dimension a date. text: a note, only `text`.

field.description: A dimension of the block's dataset.

value.description: One value for eq / neq / gt / gte / lt / lte, a list for in / not_in, [low, high] for between, nothing for is_empty / is_not_empty.

filters.description: Filters for every block of the report. Each viewer can override them for themselves.

interview_ids.description: Interviews to show (interview ids from list_interviews), combined with the other picks by OR. Nothing picked = all.

period.description: Either a preset, or from and to dates (YYYY-MM-DD, both inclusive, UTC). Default: last_30_days.

position_ids.description: Positions to show (position ids from list_interviews). position_ids, interview_ids and without_position are one pick list: a row shows when it belongs to ANY pick. Nothing picked = all.

without_position.description: Also pick interviews that are not part of any position (stand-alone interviews, and coaching sessions). Combined with the other picks by OR.

merchant_id.description: Optional merchant to act on. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's merchant.

name: create_report

admin_url.description: Open the report in the JobMojito admin.

published.description: false when the change was stored as a draft the owner publishes in the admin.

version.description: Send it back with the next update.

title: Create custom report
